policy: A ceiling is a maximum. The check fails when a measured value is greater than its ceiling, or when a required value was not measured. ci_initial_gzip_kb is the mock nuxt generate initial JS gzip from perf-budget.py (the chunks 200.html loads at first paint: <script src> plus <link rel=modulepreload>, never <link rel=prefetch>; the same set as csi-spl-wui/src/node/test/bundle-size.mjs). Its ceiling is 155 KB (owner, 2026-10-02, topic 87eaa57b: Let's lower it to 155), about 8 KB over the 146.9 KB the CLE-77925 cuts left. dev_initial_gzip_kb is 1.10 times the live measurement, rounded up to 0.1 KB. The other ceilings are transfer p95 of the document plus its initial JS, and p95 of GET /v1/view/me, /v1/view/channels and /v1/view/roster. Each view sample and each chunk opens its own connection. Millisecond ceilings are the greater of twice the p95 and 1.25 times the slowest sample, rounded up to a whole millisecond.

basis.headroom: ci gzip ceiling is 155 KB since 2026-10-02 (owner, topic 87eaa57b): about 8 KB of headroom over the 146.9 KB mock generate at trunk 6d129d29 (CLE-77925, n=1; live dev + prd 146.8 KB, v5.8.2). It was 160 KB (about 10 KB of headroom over the 149.7 KB generate at trunk 82d2940e, 2026-09-26, n=1; the earlier 198.6 KB over 21 chunks also counted the prefetch links, which are not first paint). dev gzip ceiling is 1.10 times 219.5 KB. View p95 is reused-connection time_starttransfer after one warmup; scored samples had time_namelookup 0 and time_connect 0 (n=12, 2026-09-25T19:50:48Z, hub 143229e55b28). Those ceilings are the greater of twice that p95 and 1.25 times the slowest sample. first-load transfer is recorded and not gated: it opens a new connection per chunk.
basis.ci_home_gzip_kb_basis: ci_home_gzip_kb is the same set rule applied to the prerendered index.html (spec 109 T002, FR-002, D3): 351.2 KB over 85 chunks on a mock nuxt generate at trunk f5a3745d8, 2026-10-08, n=1 (chunk names are content hashes, so a tree gives one value). The ceiling is that measured value with no headroom and is never ratcheted up; spec 109 T003 lowers it (target <= 175 KB).
